# GUI Interface Description

## System and Window Management

### Top Bar
- **Left Side**: "Activities" button
- **Center**: "Google Chrome" application name
- **Right Side**: 
  - Date and time: "Oct 23 17:17"
  - System icons including:
    - Notification bell
    - Network status
    - Sound volume
    - Power button

### Window Controls
- **Top Right Corner**:
  - Minimize button (dash)
  - Maximize button (square)
  - Close button (X)

## Application Windows

### Google Chrome Browser Window
- **Title Bar**: "5G towers conspiracy - Google Search"
- **Address Bar**: 
  - URL: "google.com/search?q=5G+towers+conspiracy&udm=2&sei=GiXbapP0JK23yck"
  - Search query: "5G towers conspiracy"
  - Search button (magnifying glass icon)
  - Microphone icon for voice search
  - Settings gear icon
  - Grid icon for Google apps
  - "Sign in" button
- **Navigation Bar**:
  - Back arrow
  - Forward arrow
  - Refresh button
- **Search Results**:
  - Tab: "Images" is selected
  - Other tabs: "AI Mode", "All", "News", "Videos", "Forums", "Short videos", "More", "Tools"
- **Image Results**:
  - Grid of thumbnail images related to "5G towers conspiracy"
  - Each image has a caption and source attribution (e.g., "The New York Times", "ABC News", "The Guardian")
  - Example captions:
    - "How a 5G Coronavirus Conspiracy..."
    - "Conspiracy theorists burn 5G..."
    - "Feds warn of attacks related to..."
    - "Video 5G conspiracy theories..."
    - "Broadband engineers threatened..."
    - "How a 5G Coronavirus Conspiracy..."
- **Browser Controls**:
  - Tab management (plus icon for new tab)
  - Bookmarks star icon
  - Profile icon
  - "Finish update" button

### GNU Image Manipulation Program (GIMP) Window
- **Title Bar**: "GNU Image Manipulation Program"
- **Menu Bar**: 
  - "File", "Edit", "Select", "View", "Image", "Layer", "Colors", "Tools", "Filters", "Windows", "Help"
- **Left Sidebar (Toolbox)**:
  - Tool icons including:
    - Selection tools (rectangle, ellipse, free select)
    - Drawing tools (pencil, brush, eraser)
    - Text tool (A)
    - Zoom tool (magnifying glass)
    - Clone tool
    - Crop tool
    - Color picker
    - Gradient tool
    - Pattern tool
    - Paths tool
    - Channels tool
    - Layers tool
    - History tool
    - Navigator tool
- **Left Sidebar (Crop Tool Options)**:
  - "Crop" section:
    - "Current layer only"
    - "Delete cropped pixels"
    - "Allow growing"
    - "Expand from center"
    - "Fixed" with "Aspect ratio" dropdown
    - Aspect ratio set to "1:1"
    - Position fields (X and Y coordinates in pixels)
    - Size fields (Width and Height in pixels)
    - "Highlight" section:
      - "Highlight opacity" set to "50.0"
    - "No guides" dropdown
    - "Auto Shrink" button
    - "Shrink merged" checkbox
- **Right Sidebar (Layers and Filters)**:
  - "Filter" section:
    - "Basic" filter selected
    - "Hardness 050 (51 x 51)" filter
    - Brush preview with various brush shapes
    - "Spacing" set to "10.0"
  - "Mode" dropdown set to "Normal"
  - "Opacity" set to "100.0"
  - "Lock" section with lock icons for different layer properties
  - "Layers" panel (currently empty or not visible)

## Desktop Environment

### Left Dock
- **Application Icons**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird email client
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC media player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - Terminal

  - Help icon (?)
  - Trash icon
- **Bottom Dock**:
  - Application grid icon (9x9 grid)
  - System tray icons (not fully visible)

## Visual Elements

### Colors and Layout
- **Background**: Dark gray desktop
- **Window Borders**: Light gray
